title: A September Picnic
setting: A sunny park with green grass in September.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

sentences.en: Mia and Ben begin a picnic in September.
sentences.zh: 九月，米娅和本开始野餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) spread a picnic blanket on green grass in a park with a few early autumn leaves.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children starting a picnic; the month can't be shown.

sentences.en: Mia brings forty small chocolates and cool drinks.
sentences.zh: 米娅带来了四十块小巧克力和清凉的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) opens a box full of small chocolates next to cold drinks on the blanket.
sentences.draw_note: Shows many small chocolates and cold drinks; the exact number can't be counted.

sentences.en: Ben sees something in the middle of the grass.
sentences.zh: 本看见草地中间有个东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) points at something small in the middle of the grass.

sentences.en: Maybe it is a lost pet.
sentences.zh: 也许它是一只走丢的宠物。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) look curiously at a small animal shape half hidden in the grass.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children looking at a small animal; 'maybe' and 'lost' can't be shown.

sentences.en: It is a puppy the size of a shoe.
sentences.zh: 那是一只只有鞋子大小的小狗。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tiny puppy, as small as a shoe, sits on the grass next to the shoe of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts).

sentences.en: A girl runs over, too happy to say anything.
sentences.zh: 一个女孩跑过来，高兴得说不出话。
sentences.scene_prompt: A little girl in a blue dress runs across the grass toward the puppy with a big happy face.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a happy girl running to the puppy; 'too happy to say anything' is only in her face.

sentences.en: She never wants to lose her puppy again.
sentences.zh: 她再也不想弄丢她的小狗了。
sentences.scene_prompt: The little girl in a blue dress hugs the tiny puppy tightly, Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) smiling.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the girl hugging the puppy tightly; 'never again' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Sharing chocolate with her is an easy thing.
sentences.zh: 和她分享巧克力是件很容易的事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) give chocolates to the little girl in a blue dress on the picnic blanket, the puppy beside them.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children sharing chocolates; 'easy thing' can't be shown.
